_comment: CURATED+VERIFIED exaltation map (re-verified 2026-10 against RealmEye dungeon pages + DECA patch notes; see META.md). Completing an exalt dungeon on an 8/8 character banks progress; milestones give PERMANENT, per-class stat bonuses. 'efficiency' = community consensus on exalts-per-hour (high = grind these; low = run for loot/completion, not as a grind). 2026-10 corrections: Ice CAVE is not an exalt dungeon — its rebuild, Ice CITADEL (Esben the Neurotic), is the SPD exalt; The Void is Mana only (the Vial of Pure Darkness just opens it); The Shatters is Attack only but grants TWO per run (Twilight Archmage + Forgotten King). Not modelled here (no fixed dungeon entry): Neo Wormholes (S29 P2 — exalt stat set by the wormhole's colour, only if you beat the timer and kill the Satellite Core) and Legacy Shatters in the Time Chamber (S30 P2 — Attack exalt).
_milestoneNote: 5/10/15/20/25 completions of a given dungeon = +1/+2/+3/+4/+5 to its stat(s); Life & Mana give 5x (max +25). Per class, permanent. Watch for Double Exaltation calendar events (e.g. Spectral Penitentiary + O3, May 2025) — that's the time to grind.

the-nest.note: Killer Bee Queen -> Dexterity. Fast & repeatable — the go-to DEX exalt grind. Its hard variant is now the Plagued Nest (formerly Advanced Nest): 50% less healing instead of extra damage, +30% loot.

ice-citadel.note: Esben the Neurotic -> guaranteed Speed exalt. The Ice Cave rebuilt harder (Blizzard frostbite meter). Standalone — no Lost Halls → Cultist chain needed, so it's the direct SPD route.

kogbold-steamworks.note: Factory Control Core -> Vitality. Dangerous but fast; also drops Greater stat pots. Portal from the Kogbold Expedition Engine encounter (drops a regular AND an Advanced portal). Best VIT exalt.

fungal-cavern.note: Crystal Worm Mother -> Wisdom, and she drops the Crystal Cavern entrance (also WIS) — 2 WIS exalts per chain.

crystal-cavern.note: Crystal Entity -> Wisdom. Entered from the Fungal Cavern boss — run them back-to-back for 2 WIS exalts.

spectral-penitentiary.note: Soulwarden Murcian -> Attack. Also drops Greater DEF/Mana pots.

the-shatters.note: Attack x2 per run — the Twilight Archmage AND The Forgotten King each grant one. Long & dangerous, but the double exalt makes it the strongest ATT exalt per run.

lost-halls.note: Marble Colossus -> Defense. Gateway to Cultist Hideout (SPD) and The Void (Mana).

cultist-hideout.note: Malus -> Speed. Opened from inside Lost Halls; Malus drops the Vial of Pure Darkness that opens The Void.

moonlight-village.note: Last dancer decides the stat: Sage Genji -> Life, Drummer Kaguya -> Mana, Dancer Miko -> Attack. Regular difficulty also guarantees a Greater Life pot.

the-void.note: Void Entity -> Mana. Top difficulty; opened in the Lost Halls boss room with a Vial of Pure Darkness (from Malus).

oryx-sanctuary.note: Oryx 3 -> Life, with a 50% chance of a BONUS exaltation. Needs Sword + Shield + Helmet runes. Very time-consuming — run for loot/completions, not as a grind.
